purpose: Second fresh generality batch: a new set of real open-source apps pinned to a commit, scanned with an empty ledger. Each scanRoot points at one coherent application; the MinimalApiPlayground repository contains three independent apps and is scanned three times with separate roots. Expected route counts were verified by reading each project's route registrations directly, never from the scanner output.

scoring.notes: Deterministic = provable from source. AiReview = contract the deterministic pass honestly cannot prove (opaque ORM/service returns, dynamic serializers, custom binders, non-compiled scratch entry points); routed to the interactive AI gap review where the user accepts/edits/rejects each fragment (tagged x-ai-inferred). These are reported separately, never silently merged, and never hard-coded.
